title: Tackling Online Abuse: A Survey of Automated Abuse Detection Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying NLP datasets annotated for sexism (e.g., Waseem and Hovy, HatEval 2019) and reviewing literature on mitigating algorithmic gender bias in automated moderation systems.
Reviewing existing datasets and computational models designed to detect racism in online user-generated content (e.g., tweets, comments).
Surveying datasets and approaches focused on detecting hate speech based on religion, including word-sense disambiguation tasks for detecting anti-semitic language.
Reviewing shared tasks and datasets (e.g., HatEval 2019) that focus on detecting hate speech and aggressive behavior directed against immigrants.
